introduction.text:
Targeted towards franchisors, the website showcases their 24-hour concept and product offerings. Available in both Portuguese and French versions to cater to their next market endeavor, the site features a typical Portuguese city illustration animated from day (header) to night (footer), complete with immersive details like vending sounds and contextual field recordings.

Centered around a coffee cup as a key WebGl element, the scroll guides users through the benefits and process from initial contact to a fully operational vending shop in just one month, supported by robust marketing, technical assistance, and a comprehensive Grab&Go experience. With a vibrant and dynamic online presence, the site features living illustrations from header to footer, incorporating motion graphics and multiple animated blocks to enhance the scroll narrative and engage users effectively.
introduction.title: Grab&Go is the largest Portuguese vending machine network, boasting over 220 stores across the country.

titleGroup: In a world that never sleeps, Grab&Go has redefined convenience with over 220 stores. An ideal choice for franchising — You rest, your business doesn't.

props.text:
Centered on a coffee cup as a key WebGL element, the scroll guides users through the journey from first contact to a fully operational vending shop in just one month backed by strong marketing, technical support, and a complete 360º Grab&Go experience. B2B first? Yes, but consumers are the real brand champions. Business without people is just business, and branding is all about them.

The site’s vibrant presence comes to life with dynamic illustrations, motion graphics, and animated blocks that enhance the scroll narrative and engage users seamlessly. And Grab&Go coffee? You should try it.
props.title: Website

props.text:
The original website, also crafted by us, revolved around a single store seamlessly integrated into a detailed cityscape—a concept that stood strong and relevant for 13 years. For the new website, we aimed to preserve that legacy by illustrating a quintessential Portuguese city, showcasing the store within its façade. Architectural elements and a sense of familiarity were further emphasized with interactive audio elements—for instance, clicking on the bicycle triggers a sound sample and you have city birds chipping far away.

We extended this illustrative approach to include various vending machine configurations, culminating in the movable star module featured in a playful beach setting at the footer. This ties seamlessly into the brand’s 24-hour availability, highlighted by illustrations transitioning from day to night, a tribute to the original site’s dynamic sky variations.

And for a bit of fun? Clicking on the radio brings up a sonic surprise—Buraka Som Sistema. You’re welcome. Yes, we had some spare time on our hands… and still do, honestly. Why someone’s on the beach with their lights on? That remains one of Sesimbra’s eternal mysteries. It’s just that good.
props.title: Illustration

props.quote: Büro has assisted Grab&Go on two separate occasions. Initially, back in 2011 when we operated just two stores, they crafted a brand and website that has served us exceptionally well for over 13 years. More recently, they revamped our website now one of Europe's largest vending machine franchising business. While they may not be the cheapest option, their commitment to delivering exceptional work is truly inspiring.
